name: Capmatinib (MET exon-14 skipping NSCLC)
supportiveCare: Continuous oral dosing until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
Monitor for peripheral edema, nausea, and interstitial lung disease/pneumonitis.

drugs.name: Capmatinib
drugs.notes: Capmatinib 400 mg PO twice daily, continuous, for MET exon-14 skipping alterations. Tepotinib 450 mg PO once daily is an accepted alternative MET inhibitor. Twice-daily flat oral dose modeled per day of the cycle. My own wording.
